mapper.select: select dev.`id` as `deviceId`, dev.`device_parent_id` as `deviceParentId`, dev.`device_number` as `deviceNumber`, dev.`name` as `deviceName`, dev.`product_id` as `productId`, prod.`prod_name` as `productName`, dev.`status` as `onlineState` from `iot_dev_device` dev join `iot_md_product` prod on dev.`product_id` = prod.`id` where dev.`id` = #{deviceDetailParam.deviceId}
select prop.`name` as `propName`, prop.`prop_code` as `propCode` from `iot_dev_device` dev join `iot_md_product_prop` prop on dev.`product_id` = prop.`prod_id` where dev.`id` = #{deviceId}

SELECT dev.`id` AS `deviceId`, dev.`name` AS `deviceName`, dev.`tenant` AS `tenantId`, prop.`id` AS `propId`, prop.`prod_id` AS `prodId`, prop.`prop_code` AS `propCode`, prop.`name` AS `propName`, prop.`data_type` AS `dataType`, prop.`precision` AS `dataPrecision`, prop.`data_write` AS `dataWrite`, prop.`data_config` AS `dataConfig`, prop.`default_value` AS `defaultValue`, (select `unit_name` from `iot_sys_unit` item where item.`unit_code` = prop.`unit_code`) AS `unitName`, prod.`prod_category_id` AS `prodCategoryId`, (select `item_value` from `iot_sys_dict_item` item where item.`id` = prod.`prod_category_id`) AS `prodCategoryCode`, (select `item_value` from `iot_sys_dict_item` item where item.`id` = prod.`prod_brand_id`) AS `prodBrandCode` FROM `iot_dev_device` dev JOIN `iot_md_product_prop` prop ON dev.`product_id` = prop.`prod_id` JOIN `iot_md_product` prod ON dev.`product_id` = prod.`id` WHERE dev.`id` = #{deviceId} and prop.`prop_code` = #{propCode} and dev.`deleted` = 0 and prop.`deleted` = 0 and prod.`deleted` = 0

SELECT dev.`id` AS `deviceId`, dev.`name` AS `deviceName`, dev.`device_number` AS `deviceNumber`, dev.`device_parent_id` AS `parentDeviceId`, (select `device_number` from `iot_dev_device` where `id` = dev.`device_parent_id`) as `parentDeviceNumber`, dev.`tenant` AS `tenantId`, prod.`id` AS `prodId`, prod.`prod_version` AS `prodVersion`, prod.`protocol_id` AS `protocolId`, prod.`node_type` AS `nodeType`, prod.`prod_category_id` AS `productCategoryId`, prod.`prod_number` AS `productNumberCode`, prod.`prod_brand_id` AS `productBrandCode`, dev.`raw_device_id` AS `rawDeviceId`, dev.`status` AS `status` FROM `iot_dev_device` dev JOIN `iot_md_product` prod ON dev.`product_id` = prod.`id` WHERE dev.`id` = #{deviceId} AND dev.`deleted` = 0 AND prod.`deleted` = 0
SELECT dev.`raw_device_id` AS `rawDeviceId`, dev.`config` AS `config` FROM `iot_dev_device` dev WHERE dev.`id` = #{deviceId} AND dev.`deleted` = 0
SELECT dev.`id` FROM `iot_dev_device` dev WHERE dev.`raw_device_id` = #{rawDeviceId} AND dev.`deleted` = 0
